title: The Broken Veil
author: Mirabel Joubert
blurb: Sable Amberdale, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
